text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHCDOG03, Boxer Front Door Knocker

The Boxer Door Knocker is a great way to let your visitors know about the person and the dog living in your home. This wonderfully detailed Boxer Front Door Knocker captures the intelligence and playfulness that Boxer dog breeds are known for. This door knocker is made from brass with a oiled bronze finish that really bring out the beauty of not only the coloring, but also the detailing. This Boxer Knocker comes packaged with the mounting hardware to install it on wood or metal doors.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Features and Specifications of the Boxer Dog Door Knocker:

  • Material: Brass
  • Finish: Oiled Bronze
  • Height: 5-3/4"
  • Width: 3-3/4"
  • Projection Off Door: 4"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
